newsitem.title: USA: Best Buy November same store sales down.
newsitem.headline: Best Buy November same store sales down.

text.p: Best Buy Co said Thursday its same store sales for the four-week period ending November 30 were down eight percent versus last year.
During the comparable period last year, which ended November 25, same store sales increased 15 percent, the company said.
Total November sales were $767 million, up two percent from the previous November's $750 million.
Sales for the third fiscal quarter were $2.007 billion, a four percent increase over $1.929 billion for the comparable period last year.
Sales for the first three quarters of fiscal 1997 -- 39 weeks -- were $5.423 billion, an increase of 17 percent over $4.642 billion for the comparable period last year.
For the fiscal third quarter, comparable store sales fell eight percent and year-to-date decreased one percent.

"Third quarter sales were well below earlier expectations," Allen Lenzmeier, chief financial officer, said in a statement. "In addition, the personal computer category became more promotional in November."
Best Buy is a retailer of name-brand consumer electronics, personal computers and appliances.
